verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing supports webhooks for relayed authorization events with strict reply-time requirements, configured via Customer Area, indicating webhook-based event subscription exists. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose webhook subscription API/config for arbitrary event types beyond authorization, nor documentation of a standard/self-service webhook management endpoint typical of agentic integration. Missing for 10: broader webhook event catalog (non-authorization events), programmatic webhook subscription/management API, and independent corroboration of webhook reliability.
